column3: The Hebrew has the end of the earth in the singular; BSB has ends.
The Hebrew names the inheritance of those fearing Your name; BSB describes an inheritance reserved for them.
The Hebrew says adding days upon the king’s days and generation and generation; BSB speaks of his life and many generations.
The Hebrew names loving devotion and truth without possessives; BSB adds Your to both.
The Hebrew makes fulfilling the vows a purpose of singing; BSB coordinates singing and fulfilling them.
